subject: Update redis to server in internal variable names in benchmark source code (#2141)
reason: The change only renames the internal variable/struct field `redis_config` to `server_config` in src/valkey-benchmark.c (in the global config struct and clusterNode struct), updating all references consistently. No logic, output, memory management, or user-visible behavior of valkey-benchmark changes, and any missed reference would be a compile error rather than a runtime bug. A pure identifier rename needs no test scenario.
